main_text.p: feruandæ. Teftimonia tum adhiberi fo-lent, cùm fcribendum aliquid eft nobis, quod nouum, incredibile, atque inufita-tum effe videtur. Comparata autem exag-gerandi & amplificandi gratia interdum vfurpantur, quoties fcilicet nō nudè tan-tùm ac fimpliciter negotium aliquod ex-ponendum, verùm etiam, comparatione cum aliis facta,eiufdem honeftas,vel tur-pitudo: damnum vel commodum often-dendum eft.Motus verò in his,pro diuer-Sententiæ [illegible, ~6 letters] mouentes.fitate rerum, de quibus fcribitur,variè eft inftituendus,& excitandus vel mifericor-diæ, in aduerfa, partim noftra, partim a-liorum fortuna: vel iræ, odij,indignatio-nis:cùm res exponitur indigna,iniqua,a-trox: vel amoris aut læticiæ, quando quæ nunciantur grata, læta, iucunda funt. Vt Sententiæ [illegible, ~5 letters] mora-te & conci-liantes.contra [illegible, ~7 letters] quoque & [illegible, ~3 letters] nihil hîc agatur: opera danda eft primùm,ne,quod prouerbio dici folet,ab ouo vfque ad ma-la res exponantur, & altius, quàm opor-tet,repetantur. Deinde,vt [illegible, ~7 letters] curiosi-tatis declinetur fufpicio, atque inftitutæ fcriptionis rationes ac caufæ reddantur, defumptæ ab officio noftro: à rei necessi-tate utilitate, honeftare,iucunditate &vo-luptate. Collocatio verò atque tractatio

page.notes: Marginal Greek in both notes is too small to read reliably and is marked illegible. The Greek in the text line "contra" and "Deinde,vt" is also uncertain and marked illegible. The line "&vo-luptate" and "utilitate" are read from a worn line, with the printed hyphen not clearly visible. The first note's Latin keyword is read as "Sententiæ"; the second as "Sententiæ". The running text is set as one paragraph because no indent is visible. The catchword "tribus" is shown at the foot and not repeated in the text.
